title: Opposition-Aligned 'Resistance Units' Stage Nationwide Anti-Execution Campaign
detail: Iran's opposition-aligned Resistance Units claimed a coordinated campaign of graffiti and placard displays across Tehran, Shiraz, Isfahan, Tabriz, and Kermanshah, protesting state executions and demanding the release of political prisoners. Reported slogans included 'Political prisoners must be freed' and 'No to state executions' in Tehran, 'No to the regime of executions' in Shiraz, and 'Justice will not be achieved with executions' in Tabriz. The campaign follows a wave of executions of protesters convicted in connection with the January 2026 uprising.

sources.name: National Council of Resistance of Iran (NCRI)

media.caption: Resistance Units campaign against executions spreads across Iranian cities

confidenceReason: Single-source report from an opposition group (NCRI/MEK-affiliated); not independently corroborated by wire services as of this update.
